title: Let Your Agent Write the Scene
sourceTitle: Original promo: let your Agent write the scene

scenes.title: The Scene in Your Head
scenes.narration: Picture a sentence falling into water, rising back out of the ripples. But no template has that scene. Does it have to stay in your head?
scenes.sourceQuote: Picture a sentence falling into water, rising back out of the ripples. But no template has that scene. Does it have to stay in your head?

scenes.title: Write the Scene Down
scenes.narration: Write down the scene in Galanty. Then hand it to your Agent. It turns your words into animation. Text, ripples and timing land as you meant.
scenes.sourceQuote: Write down the scene in Galanty. Then hand it to your Agent. It turns your words into animation. Text, ripples and timing land as you meant.

scenes.title: From a Sentence to a Scene
scenes.narration: Watch: the words land first. Rings push out from their center, and sparks drift along the ripples. One sentence becomes a scene you can see.
scenes.sourceQuote: Watch: the words land first. Rings push out from their center, and sparks drift along the ripples. One sentence becomes a scene you can see.

props.rippleTitle: From one sentence to one scene

scenes.title: Tune the Feel
scenes.narration: Now ask for warm gold and a slower pace. Your Agent rewrites the scene for you. The new version grows from your first idea.
scenes.sourceQuote: Now ask for warm gold and a slower pace. Your Agent rewrites the scene for you. The new version grows from your first idea.

props.reviseTitle: Keep revising until it feels like yours

scenes.title: From Idea to Finished Film
scenes.narration: Add voice and captions in the storyboard. Render the film right on your own machine. Next time an idea strikes, open Galanty and let your Agent write it.
scenes.sourceQuote: Add voice and captions in the storyboard. Render the film right on your own machine. Next time an idea strikes, open Galanty and let your Agent write it.

props.finalTitle: Bring the idea into your film
